caseNameFull: HARRY PAISNER AND SAMUEL PAISNER, CO-PARTNERS, DOING BUSINESS UNDER THE FIRM NAME AND STYLE OF QUALITY MANUFACTURING CO. v. United States

opinions.text:
Contract; Walsh-Healey Act. Plaintiffs entitled to recover in part.

Plaintiffs’ petition for writ of certiorari denied by tbe Supreme Court February 3, 1958.
